summary: Defines version 3 of the Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol for IPv4 and IPv6. Routers on a LAN elect one to act as the virtual router, forwarding traffic for its address, so another can take over if it fails. It is a proposed standard and was replaced by RFC 9568.

eli5.summary: Two crossing guards share one job. If the guard on duty goes home, the other steps in right away. This was later replaced by a newer version.
